title: Widgets follow the active tab: Network, Room, Players, Hints, Log, Console
covers: Widget layout and the session context bound to the active tab
context: Around the main window the widgets follow the session tab you look at. Network sits on the left over Room, Players over Hints on the right, and Log, Console and Spoiler at the bottom. In the lobby phase they show the lobby (seats, pending joins, lobby log). In the live phase they show the room. A session with a room password shows its data without a password prompt.
changed: widgets: Network, lobby phase states, session context from the active tab

setup.label: launch
setup.text: The bundle-4 launch above. If the welcome tour opens by itself, press Skip.

setup.label: game
setup.text: A Link to the Past installed: Library, Games, tab Built-in, press Add on its card.

setup.label: engine
setup.text: Ready (the Engine page under App shows Ready).

setup.label: sessions
setup.text: Two saved sessions, Alpha and Beta, each with one player of A Link to the Past. Give Beta a Room password in How players join.

setup.label: layout
setup.text: A profile that still has the old widget layout may need the layout reset in the Widgets menu before step 1.

steps: Run Alpha and then Beta from Sessions, so two tabs are open (Beta in front). Look around the main window: Network on the left over Room, Players over Hints on the right, Log, Console and Spoiler as tabs at the bottom.

Beta is in the Lobby phase. Players lists its seats, Room says it is not running, Log shows lobby events and Network shows the lobby server state and the reach facts (Lobby address, Network mode, Seen on your network).
Press the tab Alpha. Players now lists the seats of Alpha. The widgets follow the tab you look at.

Press Run in Beta and wait for Hosting. Players shows the player, Room shows the Seed and Output, Hints lists hints, Log shows Hosting game at, Console accepts commands, and no password prompt appears for Beta.
Press the tab Alpha again. The widgets show the lobby of Alpha, not the room of Beta. Press Beta: they show its room again.
Open the Spoiler tab for Beta. It shows the spoiler of the run, or a line saying it is not available.
Close both tabs. The widgets say there is no session.
pass: The default layout puts Network over Room on the left, Players over Hints on the right, and Log, Console and Spoiler below.
Each widget shows the data of the active tab, in the lobby phase and in the live phase, and switches when you change tab.
A session with a room password shows its room data in the widgets with no password prompt.
fail: A widget shows the data of another tab, or stays on the first session.
A widget shows a password prompt or a needs-a-password message for a session whose password is set.
A widget is missing, or Players stays empty in the lobby phase.
notes: Optional: pop a widget out to its own window. It follows the active tab too.
The Network widget shows the same facts that used to be on the Servers screen. Servers keeps the Network mode setting and a line with a button Open the Network widget.
